articles.title: Judge temporarily blocks prediction platform Kalshi on New Mexico tribal lands
articles.summary: A federal judge hit pause on Kalshi's attempt to operate a prediction market platform on New Mexico tribal lands, likely due to jurisdictional conflicts between tribal sovereignty and federal gambling regulations. This skirmish matters because it's the first real legal test of whether prediction platforms can use tribal gaming exemptions to dodge CFTC oversight, and the answer will determine if that loophole actually exists.

articles.title: Small businesses using prediction markets to offset losses | Tomorrow's headlines tonight
articles.summary: Small business owners are hedging their operational risks by betting against themselves in prediction markets, essentially turning their business forecasts into insurance policies. This signals that prediction markets are finally crossing over from pure speculation into actual risk management, which means volume and legitimacy just got a serious bump.

articles.title: Van Hollen Calls Senate Democratic Leader Race 'Wide Open' as Prediction Markets Favor Schumer
articles.summary: Senate Democrats are picking their next leader, and Van Hollen says it's anyone's game despite prediction markets heavily favoring Schumer to keep the role. The gap between political rhetoric and market odds creates an arbitrage opportunity if Van Hollen knows something the smart money doesn't.

articles.title: Polymarket code “SILIVE” extends $25 referral promo for Celtics-Wizards
articles.summary: Polymarket's running a $25 referral bonus using code "SILIVE" that's now extended through the Celtics-Wizards matchup, meaning fresh users can stack free capital on NBA action. More free money floating around = higher trading volumes and tighter spreads on basketball markets, which is exactly what prediction markets need to stay competitive against traditional sportsbooks.

articles.title: Los Angeles Lakers Announce Partnership with Kalshi
articles.summary: The Lakers just inked a deal with Kalshi, the CFTC-regulated prediction market platform, likely for sponsorship or official betting integration. This matters because it signals major sports leagues are finally comfortable going all-in on prediction markets instead of just tolerating them from the sidelines.

articles.title: Simon Denny on Prediction Markets, Speculation, and the Future of Truth
articles.summary: Simon Denny's latest thinks prediction markets are becoming a legitimate alternative to traditional institutions for establishing what's actually true. That matters because if markets start replacing media and academia as our truth arbiters, the entire game of prediction betting gets a credibility upgrade (or a credibility problem, depending on who's doing the predicting).

articles.title: Utah drops criminal case against Kalshi after prediction market exits state
articles.summary: Utah's attempt to criminally prosecute Kalshi, a crypto-based prediction market platform, collapsed after the company simply packed up and left the state. The case signals that prediction market operators can still outrun regulatory overreach by voting with their feet, at least for now.

articles.title: Kalshi daily volume of ‘perps’ trading begins to top its prediction markets
articles.summary: Kalshi's perpetual futures contracts are now generating more daily trading volume than its original prediction market offerings. That's a problem for the prediction market thesis that derivatives exchanges exist primarily to let you bet on binary outcomes.

articles.title: Kalshi Users Under 21 Lost $8.9 Million in NYC, Probe Finds
articles.summary: Kalshi, the SEC-approved prediction market platform, has a minor problem: minors were betting on it, losing nearly $9M in New York City alone before regulators noticed. This is exactly the kind of regulatory headache that could tighten age verification requirements across the entire prediction market industry, making onboarding slower and more annoying for everyone else.

articles.title: Louisiana man allegedly threatened AG Liz Murrill’s life over battle with prediction markets
articles.summary: A Louisiana man allegedly made death threats against Attorney General Liz Murrill while she's actively pursuing legal action against prediction markets operating in the state. The escalation signals how heated the political and legal fight over online betting has become, potentially influencing how aggressively regulators move forward on enforcement.

articles.title: NFLs WAGs Now Have Prediction Market Sponsorships, Too
articles.summary: The NFL's wives and girlfriends are now cashing in on prediction market sponsorships, turning their social media clout into direct betting platform partnerships. This matters because it signals prediction markets are going mainstream through celebrity endorsements, the same playbook that made daily fantasy sports and sportsbooks household names.

articles.title: The line between sports hero and gambling shill is fast disappearing
articles.summary: Athletes are cashing massive checks to promote sportsbooks and betting apps, blurring the line between legitimate sports figures and casino marketing arms. It matters because celebrity endorsements drive retail betting volume, which creates artificial demand spikes that prediction market operators have to hedge against in real time.
